findings.conclusion: The three ordinary controls use Fixture::with_profile -> Fixture::with_study_objective, whose writer/head and selector keys are ed25519_dalek::SigningKey. The profile argument is a compatibility_digest, not a cryptographic algorithm selector.

ordinary_session/session calls inputs(), which writes authority.json with a 32-byte Ed25519 verifying_key and no authentication_profile or external_frontier. prepare_initial calls UnixFinalUseAuthorizer::open. Its absent-selector branch calls from_config -> FinalUseAuthority::open_state_dir -> open_state_dir_with_clock, selecting ClassicalV1, SystemAuthorityClock and frontier_store: None.

The explicit ml_dsa65_v2 selector calls from_pq_config and open_pq_state_dir_with_issuer_keys. It pins PQ issuer/revocation keys, requires protected external clock/frontier services, and compares the complete local FinalUse frontier with the external frontier on open. These constructors exist but are not selected by the ordinary fixture above. Unknown explicit profiles refuse; an explicitly selected PQ profile has no fallback to the absent-selector classical path.

The PQ FinalUse frontier commits its revocation head and consumed nonce set. claim and persist_or_fence perform external CAS before local persistence and fence uncertainty. It is not a root of CURRENT, Chain account/settlement state, inference journals or remote effect outcomes. CURRENT separately checks the retained signed-head floor; filesystem placement or a signed reply does not establish independent physical/admin fault domains.

The selected NPQ6 account path resolves current M06 provider/consumer ML-DSA authority in prepare_signature_metered and again at apply. For kind 11 it calls the original settle_verified_quota owner after both required witnesses. Its money/nonces/quota remain Chain State, outside the PNQ2 three-table witness root. This is a separate financial transition; ordinary model settled-read receipts do not execute or qualify it.

The independent portable ConsumptionSettlementStoreV1 candidate is separate from NPQ6 quota settlement. Its engine::verify_signature_entry requires SIGNATURE_SCHEME_ED25519_V1 and Ed25519 verify_strict against the current registered bilateral key/generation. It cannot be labeled migrated merely because the M06 NPQ6 quota path exists.

The ordinary model path opens DurableInferenceControl in prepare_initial. smollm_neural_settled_read::verify reads the same original control journal and joins the exact settled load/forward to the actual query and model identity. This observation does not issue monetary settlement, installation, CURRENT or FinalUse authority and is not evidence of Chain payment or AuthBus PQ settlement execution.

AuthBusAuthorityStore::open_pq explicitly selects MlDsa65V2. AuthBusAuthorityStore::settle resolves the current registered settlement issuer and revoked bit after acquiring the same write transaction, requires the selected key algorithm, then authenticates the evidence. The ordinary fixture calls AgentdConfig::load without installing an AuthBus trust/checkpoint file; load initializes both optional fields to None. These ordinary controls do not demonstrate the explicit PQ AuthBus settlement wiring. This statement does not assert that all AuthBus callers are classical or that its PQ API is absent.
